name: locks-with-on-fail-test-044696e74b/locks-with-on-fail-v.bal
spec_references: ## Statements: "[Lock statement](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#lock-stmt)" is listed, but fail statements and on-fail clauses are not listed as supported statements/behavior.
reason: The case requires explicit fail statements and on-fail handlers on nested locks, including error binding patterns and continuation after handled failures. Although lock statements and check expressions are listed, fail statements and on-fail handling are not covered by the supported feature list. These behaviors are essential to the asserted state changes, extracted error details, and nested-handler execution order.
unsupported_constructs: on fail clauses on lock statements, including error binding patterns
test_design_notes: io:println only exposes output; it is not the reason for the feature classification.
The assertions require handlers to extract nested cause, tuple and record details and distinguish handled inner failures from outer failures.
